vl_pop_culture_to_group_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { culture = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_african } }
        change_pop_culture = { target = cu:swahili value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { culture = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_central_asian } }

vl_country_cultures_to_group_effect = {
    save_scope_as = vl_country
    every_primary_culture = {
        save_scope_as = vl_old_culture
        if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_african }
            cu:swahili = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_central_asian }
            cu:kazak = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_east_asian }
            cu:han = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european }
            cu:french = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_indigenous_american }
            cu:cherokee = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_indigenous_oceanic }
            cu:hawaiian = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_middle_eastern }
            cu:turkish = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_north_asian }
            cu:manchu = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_promethean }
            cu:promethean = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian }
            cu:bengali = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_southeast_asian }
            cu:vietnamese = { save_scope_as = vl_new_culture }
        }
        scope:vl_country = { add_primary_culture = scope:vl_new_culture }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { this = scope:vl_new_culture } }
            scope:vl_country = { remove_primary_culture = scope:vl_old_culture }
        }
    }
}
